question: P is the daughter of Q. Q is the son of R. How is P related to R?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7a4ec85919ba5967d62d477aa85ab5e05fa3e3c8bc8c11ff91486fe19ac1d56.png] 

According to the given question,

1) P is the daughter of Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c415d29a66ad1bba0cb9b0d79b15cd58b34fb9ffb24a5cb768d45af14645c53.png] 

2) Q is the son of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62095c9498b866a5b5b61ae2dee0f4c2c95f3a3aef39c9e547f9a960aae21384.png] 

 

 

**Family Structure:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/838be80606f763f042374887168628a0c5721cc367c6082e037d961a2f2190b6.png] 

 

Since P is daughter of Q

And Q is son of R

Therefore, P is child of R’s son.

**Thus, P is the Granddaughter of R.**

**Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.**
